title: SCALES: FROM FAIRNESS PRINCIPLES TO CONSTRAINED DECISION-MAKING
reasoning: The paper focuses on translating ethical and social fairness principles (such as Rawls's Maximin principle, Equity Theory, and Distributive Fairness) into mathematical constraints for decision-making. It aims to bridge the gap between ethical principles and algorithmic decision-making within the framework of Constrained Markov Decision Processes (CMDPs).
